code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (low pH, low O2 saturation, low pO2), mild anemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, lymphopenia, and elevated D-dimer, ferritin, INR, and liver enzymes. These findings suggest acute respiratory failure with systemic inflammation, possible coagulopathy, and liver involvement. Immediate clinical assessment and intervention are recommended.
